segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today's lesson is an advanced level lesson.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天的课程是高级课程。

segments.en: That means we'll be speaking using our normal English tone of voice and using some very, very difficult vocabulary and phrases.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们将使用我们正常的英语语气并使用一些非常非常困难的词汇和短语。

segments.en: So this is really good practice for all of you out there.
segments.zh: 所以这对你们所有人来说都是很好的做法。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We're going to change a little bit the dynamic of how it works.
segments.zh: 我们将稍微改变它的工作方式的动态。

segments.en: We're not going to look specifically at language takeaway or fluency builder.
segments.zh: 我们不会专门关注语言外卖或流畅性构建器。

segments.en: We're going to talk about the topic.
segments.zh: 我们要谈谈这个话题。

segments.en: We are going to pick out a couple of different words and phrases that are used in the dialogue, but we're mainly going to talk, just have a conversation and you can just listen and study a little bit of what we're saying.
segments.zh: 我们将挑选出一些用于对话中的不同单词和短语，但我们主要是要谈谈，只是进行对话，您可以只听和研究我们所说的一些内容。

segments.en: So what is the topic today, Marco?
segments.zh: 那么今天的话题是什么，马可呢？

segments.en: Well today we're going to talk about the environment, specifically about our carbon footprint.
segments.zh: 好吧，今天我们将讨论环境，特别是我们的碳足迹。

segments.en: Okay, that is the title of today's lesson.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是今天课程的标题。

segments.en: I encourage all of you to listen to the context of that phrase and we'll be back in a moment to talk about what it and some of these other phrases mean.
segments.zh: 我鼓励你们所有人听听这句话的上下文，我们稍后会回来谈论它和其他一些短语的含义。

segments.en: So what's your guys' take on all this global warming hysteria in the media?
segments.zh: 那么，您对媒体中所有这些全球变暖歇斯底里的看法是什么？

segments.en: It's pretty serious, man.
segments.zh: 这很严重，伙计。

segments.en: There have been tons of scientific studies and the scientific community says that the earth is heating up.
segments.zh: 有大量的科学研究，科学界说地球正在升温。

segments.en: We need to make some drastic changes to our lifestyle if we want to preserve our planet.
segments.zh: 如果我们想保护我们的星球，我们需要对我们的生活方式做出一些重大改变。

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: It sounds like a bunch of mumble jumble if you ask me.
segments.zh: 要我说，这听起来就是一通胡言乱语。

segments.en: The earth will save itself.
segments.zh: 地球将自救。

segments.en: It survived the worst disasters in the past.
segments.zh: 它在过去最严重的灾难中幸存下来。

segments.en: I mean, honestly, we live in the boonies.
segments.zh: 说实话，咱们住在这偏僻乡下。

segments.en: There's no way anyone here is ever going to walk or bike to work, especially in the winter.
segments.zh: 这里的任何人都不可能步行或骑自行车上班，尤其是在冬天。

segments.en: And we have no bus system.
segments.zh: 而且我们没有公共汽车系统。

segments.en: My house is 40 years old and it would take a lot of money to get it refitted to be green and energy efficient.
segments.zh: 我的房子有 40 年的历史，要把它改装成绿色和节能需要很多钱。

segments.en: Well, I don't really know if I believe in global warming either or whether or not it was our doing or a natural change the earth is going through.
segments.zh: 好吧，我真的不知道我是否相信全球变暖，或者这是否是我们所做的事情，或者是地球正在经历的自然变化。

segments.en: But you have to admit that we're living pretty irresponsibly here in the West.
segments.zh: 但你不得不承认，我们在西方不负责任地生活。

segments.en: I guess.
segments.zh: 我想是吧。

segments.en: I think the issue at hand is sustainability.
segments.zh: 我认为手头的问题是可持续性。

segments.en: We've only got this one earth we can live on and our resources are quickly disappearing because of our own carelessness and our inability to think of anyone but ourselves and anything but the present.
segments.zh: 我们只有这一个地球可以居住，可由于我们的疏忽，只顾自己、不顾别人，只看眼前、不想未来，资源正在迅速耗尽。

segments.en: So like I was saying, we need to change the way we live.
segments.zh: 所以就像我说的，我们需要改变我们的生活方式。

segments.en: We need to reduce our carbon footprint.
segments.zh: 我们需要减少我们的碳足迹。

segments.en: But it doesn't have to be that drastic.
segments.zh: 但它不必那么激烈。

segments.en: Hybrid vehicles and solar panels are too expensive to be feasible right now.
segments.zh: 混合动力汽车和太阳能电池板现在太昂贵，无法实现。

segments.en: And we don't have to be hippies living off the land and buying everything organic either.
segments.zh: 也不用像嬉皮士那样自耕自食，买什么都非得买有机的。

segments.en: Though it helps.
segments.zh: 虽然它有帮助。

segments.en: I carpool to work every day with some buddies of mine.
segments.zh: 我每天和我的一些朋友拼车上班。

segments.en: I have a rain barrel outside my house I use to water my plants and my lawn in the summer.
segments.zh: 我家外面放了一个收集雨水的桶，夏天就用里面的水浇花和浇草坪。

segments.en: And I make sure I always bring reusable bags with me when I get my groceries.
segments.zh: 我确保在我拿到杂货时总是随身携带可重复使用的袋子。

segments.en: And we just started using biodegradable plastic made from corn oil for takeout orders at my family's restaurant.
segments.zh: 我们刚刚开始在我家的餐厅使用由玉米油制成的可生物降解塑料进行外卖订单。

segments.en: Remember the three R's?
segments.zh: 还记得三个R的吗？

segments.en: Reduce, reuse, recycle.
segments.zh: 减少、重复使用、回收。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: It's just small, simple changes.
segments.zh: 它只是很小的，简单的变化。

segments.en: Like buying energy-saving light bulbs.
segments.zh: 比如买节能灯泡。

segments.en: Starting a compost bin.
segments.zh: 弄个堆肥箱。

segments.en: Recycling bottles and papers.
segments.zh: 回收瓶子和纸张。

segments.en: Using reusable water bottles.
segments.zh: 使用可重复使用的水瓶。

segments.en: Stop using disposable cups and cutlery.
segments.zh: 停止使用一次性杯子和餐具。

segments.en: Like the ones we're drinking out of?
segments.zh: 就像我们喝的那些？

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So as you probably guessed, carbon footprint, it's pretty easy.
segments.zh: 所以正如你可能猜到的，碳足迹，这很容易。

segments.en: You're talking about a footprint is the evidence you leave if you're walking on sand, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，如果您在沙滩上行走，您说的是足迹是您留下的证据。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And if we talk about carbon, we're talking about the element, right?
segments.zh: 如果我们谈论碳，我们谈论的是元素，对吧？

segments.en: Carbon.
segments.zh: 碳。

segments.en: Yep.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So carbon is something that is in everything, basically.
segments.zh: 所以碳基本上是一切事物的东西。

segments.en: It's organic.
segments.zh: 它是有机的。

segments.en: It can also, in the case of a carbon footprint, mean the amount of maybe waste or damage that we do to the earth or to the environment.
segments.zh: 在碳足迹的情况下，它也可能意味着我们对地球或环境造成的浪费或破坏的数量。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So for example, you're driving your car.
segments.zh: 例如，您正在驾驶您的汽车。

segments.en: We all know that the gas that is emitted from the exhaust pipe is CO2, right?
segments.zh: 我们都知道排气管排放的气体是二氧化碳，对吧？

segments.en: And that contains carbon.
segments.zh: 并且含有碳。

segments.en: So that's a way of seeing that you're leaving a footprint of carbon.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种看到你留下碳足迹的方式。

segments.en: You are damaging the atmosphere a little bit by driving your car.
segments.zh: 你开车会对气氛造成一点破坏。

segments.en: So in talking about a carbon footprint, we talk about having a low carbon footprint, which is good, or a very high carbon footprint, which is bad.
segments.zh: 因此，在谈论碳足迹时，我们谈论的是低碳足迹，这很好，或者非常高的碳足迹，这很糟糕。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So there were a lot of interesting things coming up in the dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以对话中出现了很多有趣的事情。

segments.en: One of the first things was...
segments.zh: 第一件事是...

segments.en: Well, the first thing that they're talking about in this dialogue is they're having kind of an argument about whether or not global warming and global climate change really exists.
segments.zh: 好吧，他们在这次对话中谈论的第一件事是他们对全球变暖和全球气候变化是否真的存在存在某种争论。

segments.en: Yeah, this is a very interesting part because some people say, well, global warming is happening, global warming is real.
segments.zh: 是的，这是一个非常有趣的部分，因为有些人说，全球变暖正在发生，全球变暖是真实的。

segments.en: And other people say, well, it's not real.
segments.zh: 其他人说，好吧，这不是真的。

segments.en: It's not really a problem.
segments.zh: 这不是一个真正的问题。

segments.en: This is just a phase that the earth will go through and like everything, it'll disappear.
segments.zh: 这只是地球将经历的一个阶段，并且喜欢一切，它会消失。

segments.en: Well, I agree with people who say that the earth goes through phases because sometimes there are centuries that are hotter and sometimes there are centuries that are colder.
segments.zh: 好吧，我同意那些说地球经历阶段的人的观点，因为有时几个世纪更热，有时有几个世纪更冷。

segments.en: But I think it's undeniable that there has been a large and immediate global climate change in the last maybe 20 years.
segments.zh: 但我认为不可否认的是，在过去的 20 年里，全球气候变化发生了巨大而直接的变化。

segments.en: Yeah, we're definitely speeding up maybe that cycle, right?
segments.zh: 是的，我们肯定会加快这个周期，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And I think that's great evidence of this and terrible evidence of this is the three earthquakes, massive earthquakes that have happened in the last couple of months.
segments.zh: 我认为这很好地证明了这一点，而这方面的可怕证据是过去几个月发生的三场地震、大地震。

segments.en: I think that earthquakes like last year and like this year are really, really important reminders that we do as humans influence the way that the world responds to us.
segments.zh: 我认为像去年和今年这样的地震确实非常重要的提醒，我们作为人类影响世界对我们的反应方式。

segments.en: I think I always see it as the earth kind of just shaking its back, kind of saying, get off me.
segments.zh: 我想我一直认为它只是在摇晃它的背部，有点说，放开我。

segments.en: Stop it.
segments.zh: 住手。

segments.en: Stop it.
segments.zh: 住手。

segments.en: That itches.
segments.zh: 那痒。

segments.en: Yeah, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: That's the way I see earthquakes sometimes.
segments.zh: 这就是我有时看到地震的方式。

segments.en: But when they were talking about, well, is it real?
segments.zh: 但是当他们谈论的时候，这是真的吗？

segments.en: Is it not?
segments.zh: 不是吗？

segments.en: They use a really interesting phrase and says, it sounds like a bunch of mumbo jumbo.
segments.zh: 他们使用了一个非常有趣的短语，并说，这听起来像是一堆胡说八道。

segments.en: Mumbo jumbo.
segments.zh: 胡说八道。

segments.en: So this is a way to say that sounds like a bunch of garbage or it sounds like a bunch of gibberish.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种说听起来像一堆垃圾的方式，或者听起来像一堆胡言乱语。

segments.en: It sounds like a bunch of people are talking about something that doesn't really exist.
segments.zh: 听起来像一群人在谈论一些不存在的东西。

segments.en: So mumbo jumbo is basically something that's not really real or true.
segments.zh: 所以胡说八道基本上是不是真的或不真实的东西。

segments.en: I think don't you also, can you use it as somebody that's saying something you don't really understand?
segments.zh: 我想你也不是，你能把它当作一个你说得不明白的人吗？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So if maybe I'm talking to you about something that's very academic and very scholarly, you say, eh, sounds like a bunch of mumbo jumbo to me.
segments.zh: 所以如果我在和你谈论一些非常学术和非常学术的东西，你说，嗯，对我来说听起来像是一堆胡言乱语。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So that's what the person said.
segments.zh: 所以这个人是这么说的。

segments.en: Ah, you know, the environmental problems are a bunch of mumbo jumbo.
segments.zh: 啊，你知道，环境问题是一堆胡说八道。

segments.en: But it was really interesting because they were like, well, we have to save the earth and well, and then there was actually a phrase here that was really kind of hard for me to understand when the person said, I mean, honestly, we live in the boonies.
segments.zh: 但这真的很有趣，因为他们就像，好吧，我们必须拯救地球，而且，当这个人说，我的意思是，当这个人说，老实说，我们生活在 Boonies 中时，我真的很难理解一个短语。

segments.en: Boonies.
segments.zh: 布尼斯。

segments.en: So what does it mean by living in the boonies?
segments.zh: 那么生活在恩人中是什么意思呢？

segments.en: This is a very common word to hear in spoken English, especially with young people.
segments.zh: 在英语口语中，这是一个非常常见的词，尤其是在年轻人中。

segments.en: Boonies means we live far away from civilization.
segments.zh: Boonies 意味着我们生活在远离文明的地方。

segments.en: We live far away from cities.
segments.zh: 我们住在远离城市的地方。

segments.en: We live far away from everything.
segments.zh: 我们生活在远离一切的地方。

segments.en: So maybe these people live in the countryside or in a small village and they don't feel like they're affected by what people in the big cities do.
segments.zh: 所以也许这些人生活在乡村或小村庄里，他们不觉得自己受到大城市人们所做的事情的影响。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So if you say, oh, I live in the boonies, you're just saying, I live really far, really far away.
segments.zh: 所以如果你说，哦，我住在 Boonies，你只是说，我住得很远，真的很远。

segments.en: So this is a very common American word.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常常见的美国词。

segments.en: I think you can also say boondocks, which is like that movie Boondock Saints.
segments.zh: 我想你也可以说 Boondocks，这就像那部电影的 Boondock Saints。

segments.en: But boondocks and boonies means very far away.
segments.zh: 但 boondocks 和 boonies 意味着很远。

segments.en: So I could say, Marco, I'm not going to drive out to your house for a party.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说，马可，我不会开车去你家参加聚会。

segments.en: You live in the boonies.
segments.zh: 你住在恩人里。

segments.en: Do you have any other ways that you can say that you live really far away?
segments.zh: 你有什么其他方式可以说你住得很远吗？

segments.en: You live in Egypt.
segments.zh: 你住在埃及。

segments.en: You live in Egypt, which for us in America is obviously very, very far away.
segments.zh: 你住在埃及，对我们在美国来说，这显然是非常非常遥远的。

segments.en: Sometimes we say, oh, the youngs, exactly.
segments.zh: 有时我们会说，哦，年轻人，确切地说。

segments.en: People in New Zealand say that.
segments.zh: 新西兰人这么说。

segments.en: I've also heard people say, oh, you live where the wind turns around.
segments.zh: 我也听过人们说，哦，你住在风转的地方。

segments.en: Really?
segments.zh: 真的吗？

segments.en: I like that one.
segments.zh: 我喜欢那个。

segments.en: It's like you live so far.
segments.zh: 就像你活到现在一样。

segments.en: Oh God, you live where the wind turns around.
segments.zh: 哦，上帝，你住在风转的地方。

segments.en: The end of the earth.
segments.zh: 地球的尽头。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: So, well, there are a lot of different ways of saying that.
segments.zh: 所以，好吧，有很多不同的说法。

segments.en: So they were talking about different aspects of the environment, like that we heard the word green or energy efficient.
segments.zh: 所以他们谈论的是环境的不同方面，就像我们听到了绿色或节能这个词。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So basically what they're doing is they're talking about some of the things they've heard in the media, maybe, or on TV about what people are supposed to be doing.
segments.zh: 所以基本上他们正在做的是他们在谈论他们在媒体上听到的一些事情，也许是在电视上，人们应该做什么。

segments.en: These are very abstract.
segments.zh: 这些非常抽象。

segments.en: That means these are very kind of big terms.
segments.zh: 这意味着这些是非常大的术语。

segments.en: Go green or be more energy efficient.
segments.zh: 走向绿色或更节能。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I've heard this, like, for example, when people say, oh, you have to be more green or go green.
segments.zh: 我听说过，例如，当人们说，哦，你必须更绿色或绿色时。

segments.en: That means more friendly towards the ecosystem, right?
segments.zh: 这意味着对生态系统更加友好，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is a very general suggestion and we can talk about specifics in a minute, but this is a very general suggestion for thinking about the environment and doing things to help it.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常笼统的建议，我们可以在一分钟内讨论具体情况，但这是一个非常普遍的建议，用于思考环境并做一些事情来帮助它。

segments.en: And so go green or be green is a way to be more environmentally friendly.
segments.zh: 因此，走向绿色或绿色是一种更环保的方式。

segments.en: We also have using energy efficient computers or light bulbs or TVs.
segments.zh: 我们还使用节能计算机或灯泡或电视。

segments.en: The third thing that they talk about, and this is something that comes up a lot, is sustainability.
segments.zh: 他们谈论的第三件事，这是很多事情，是可持续性。

segments.en: Yeah, that's a big word that a lot of people like to use in this type of topic, sustainability.
segments.zh: 是的，这是很多人喜欢在这类话题中使用的一个大词，可持续性。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So sustainability comes from the word to sustain.
segments.zh: 因此，可持续性源自于维持的词语。

segments.en: That means to hold out over time or to continue.
segments.zh: 这意味着随着时间的推移或继续。

segments.en: So you think about something, maybe sustainability is, I think, in many cases about doing or having habits, doing things that you can continue to do for a long time.
segments.zh: 所以你想一些事情，我认为，在许多情况下，可持续性可能是关于做或养成的，做你可以继续做很长时间的事情。

segments.en: For example, driving a big SUV to work every day is not keeping in mind sustainability because one day there will be no oil.
segments.zh: 例如，每天开着一辆大型 SUV 上班并不牢记可持续性，因为有一天不会有石油。

segments.en: So then what do we do?
segments.zh: 那么我们该怎么办呢？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So that's not a sustainable action.
segments.zh: 所以这不是一个可持续的行动。

segments.en: Sustainable actions mean that we have less negative impact on the world.
segments.zh: 可持续行动意味着我们对世界的负面影响较小。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So basically what you're trying to do is to sustain, which means to hold, to withstand these habits, for example.
segments.zh: 所以基本上你想做的是维持，这意味着保持，以承受这些习惯。

segments.en: So when you talk about a sustainable ecosystem, it means that it has everything it needs and it can continue to work for a very, very long time.
segments.zh: 因此，当您谈论可持续的生态系统时，这意味着它拥有所需的一切，并且可以继续工作很长时间。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you can also talk about sustainable development, which we talk about in aid and giving aid to other countries.
segments.zh: 因此，您也可以谈论可持续发展，我们在援助和援助其他国家方面进行了讨论。

segments.en: So sustainable development is trying to help other countries or other people in ways that they can continue to do for a long time.
segments.zh: 因此，可持续发展正试图以他们可以长期继续做的方式帮助其他国家或其他人。

segments.en: It's also very popular with tourism.
segments.zh: 它也很受旅游业的欢迎。

segments.en: They talk about sustainable tourism.
segments.zh: 他们谈论可持续旅游。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: That means thinking about the environment and having tourism that can last forever, not tourism that will destroy the environment because it's very harmful.
segments.zh: 这意味着考虑环境和拥有可以永远持续下去的旅游业，而不是旅游业，因为它非常有害。

segments.en: It's a very interesting topic.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: And as you say, it's used in a wide range of cases, sustainable development, sustainable projects, sustainable tourism.
segments.zh: 正如您所说，它用于广泛的案例，可持续发展，可持续项目，可持续旅游。

segments.en: There are a lot of different ways that people use this, but it's basically the same thing.
segments.zh: 人们使用它有很多不同的方式，但它基本上是一样的。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It's in essence, it refers to that.
segments.zh: 它本质上是指它。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Keeping something going over time.
segments.zh: 让某事随着时间的推移。

segments.en: But I think the big question here is if you want to go green, if you want to be environmentally friendly, what do you do?
segments.zh: 但我认为这里最大的问题是如果你想绿色环保，如果你想环保，你会怎么做？

segments.en: Because it's not about big ideas.
segments.zh: 因为这与大创意无关。

segments.en: It's about specifics.
segments.zh: 这是关于细节的。

segments.en: It's about changing your everyday actions.
segments.zh: 这是关于改变你的日常行为。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So these guys had a couple of ideas.
segments.zh: 所以这些人有几个想法。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: They came up with something like, for example, hybrid vehicles, which is a big thing now.
segments.zh: 他们想出了类似混合动力汽车的东西，这现在是一件大事。

segments.en: Basically hybrid means two, right?
segments.zh: 基本上混合意味着两个，对吧？

segments.en: It's a combination of two or more.
segments.zh: 它是两种或多种的组合。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So, you know the Sphinx in Egypt?
segments.zh: 那么，你知道埃及的狮身人面像吗？

segments.en: That's a hybrid.
segments.zh: 那是一个混合体。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Between a man and a lion.
segments.zh: 在一个人和一个狮子之间。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So a hybrid vehicle basically uses gasoline, but also electricity.
segments.zh: 所以混合动力汽车主要使用汽油，但也使用电力。

segments.en: So they're actually very efficient because-
segments.zh: 所以它们实际上非常高效，因为——

segments.en: And they're quiet.
segments.zh: 他们很安静。

segments.en: They're quiet.
segments.zh: 他们很安静。

segments.en: And usually where you use up most of your gasoline is in traffic.
segments.zh: 通常你用完大部分汽油的地方是交通。

segments.en: Because your car is on, you're accelerating, you're braking, you're accelerating, you're braking.
segments.zh: 因为你的车开着，你在加速，你在刹车，你在加速，你正在刹车。

segments.en: So in this case, I think hybrid vehicles run on the electric engine until they hit, I think it's 30 miles per hour.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，我认为混合动力汽车在电动发动机上运行，直到它们撞到，我认为它是每小时 30 英里。

segments.en: And once you surpass that, then it switches to the gas engine, which obviously if you have a constant high speed, it's more efficient, the combustion of the gasoline.
segments.zh: 一旦你超过了它，它就会切换到燃气发动机，显然如果你有一个恒定的高速，它会更有效，就是汽油的燃烧。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So a good example of a hybrid vehicle is the Toyota Prius.
segments.zh: 因此，混合动力汽车的一个很好的例子是丰田普锐斯。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I think it was like the first one commercially available.
segments.zh: 我认为这就像第一个市售的。

segments.en: But now they have all kinds and they're actually trying to make entirely electric cars.
segments.zh: 但现在他们有各种各样的，他们实际上是在努力制造完全电动汽车。

segments.en: So lots of things to watch out for there.
segments.zh: 那里有很多需要注意的事情。

segments.en: But they also talked about something for the house, right?
segments.zh: 但他们也为房子谈论了一些事情，对吧？

segments.en: So if you want to not just have a nice car that is environmentally friendly, but also to do things with your house, what can you put on your roof?
segments.zh: 因此，如果您不仅想拥有一辆环保的好车，还想为您的房子做事，您可以在屋顶上放什么？

segments.en: I think we've seen a lot of these.
segments.zh: 我想我们已经看到了很多这样的东西。

segments.en: These are called solar panels.
segments.zh: 这些被称为太阳能电池板。

segments.en: Solar has to do with the sun.
segments.zh: 太阳与太阳有关。

segments.en: So solar power, solar panel, that means energy that comes from the sun.
segments.zh: 所以太阳能，太阳能电池板，这意味着来自太阳的能量。

segments.en: So the sun.
segments.zh: 于是太阳。

segments.en: And a panel is like a pad or like some kind of device that can take the energy from the sun.
segments.zh: 面板就像一个垫子或某种可以从太阳中吸收能量的设备。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It's really, really good.
segments.zh: 真的，真的很好。

segments.en: Basically, in some places you have anywhere between eight to 12 hours of sunlight.
segments.zh: 基本上，在某些地方，您的阳光时间在 8 到 12 小时之间。

segments.en: So the whole day, these panels are absorbing energy.
segments.zh: 所以一整天，这些面板都在吸收能量。

segments.en: You can store them maybe in batteries and then just use them later.
segments.zh: 您可以将它们存储在电池中，然后再使用它们。

segments.en: So basically you don't really need to use electricity that comes from coal or from nuclear power plants because you want to turn on a light.
segments.zh: 所以基本上你真的不需要使用来自煤炭或核电站的电力，因为你想打开灯。

segments.en: It doesn't really use up a lot of electricity.
segments.zh: 它并没有真正消耗大量电。

segments.en: And there's no waste.
segments.zh: 而且没有浪费。

segments.en: And there's no waste.
segments.zh: 而且没有浪费。

segments.en: It's all clean.
segments.zh: 一切都很干净。

segments.en: So my question for you, does Ecuador have a lot of solar panels everywhere?
segments.zh: 所以我的问题是，厄瓜多尔到处都有很多太阳能电池板吗？

segments.en: Because you guys have so much sunlight down there.
segments.zh: 因为你们那里有这么多的阳光。

segments.en: We don't really have a lot of them.
segments.zh: 我们真的没有很多。

segments.en: It's not a big commercial thing yet, but there are a lot of projects going around to help implement these things a lot better.
segments.zh: 这还不是一件大事，但有很多项目正在进行中，以帮助更好地实施这些事情。

segments.en: For example, taking these technologies to the countryside where people don't have access to electricity by means of cables.
segments.zh: 例如，将这些技术带到人们无法通过电缆获得电力的乡村。

segments.en: So they're implementing that there, getting them to use it.
segments.zh: 所以他们在那里实现它，让他们使用它。

segments.en: But it's still expensive.
segments.zh: 但是还是很贵的。

segments.en: That's the problem with solar panels is that, of course, it's an energy efficient way of going.
segments.zh: 这就是太阳能电池板的问题，当然，它是一种节能的方式。

segments.en: It'll save you money in the long run, but up front, you've got to spend a lot of money.
segments.zh: 从长远来看，它会为您省钱，但在前面，您必须花很多钱。

segments.en: Well, here's a good way to use sustaining.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是使用维持的好方法。

segments.en: If someone in the countryside has solar panels in their house, it's a self-sustaining way to produce energy.
segments.zh: 如果乡下的人家里有太阳能电池板，这是一种自我维持的生产能源的方式。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So you can spend on another place or a person.
segments.zh: 所以你可以花在另一个地方或一个人上。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Actually, this is a very popular thing in many developed countries.
segments.zh: 实际上，这在许多发达国家是很受欢迎的。

segments.en: I remember when I was living in Chile, big buildings were being marketed as energy efficient and green by showing that they can be self-sustaining.
segments.zh: 我记得当我住在智利时，大型建筑通过表明它们可以自我维持而被推销为节能和绿色。

segments.en: So basically, they would have solar panels on the roof.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，他们会在屋顶上安装太阳能电池板。

segments.en: They would collect sunlight all day, and then they had big batteries that would store this energy and then you can use it.
segments.zh: 他们会整天收集阳光，然后他们有大电池来储存这种能量，然后你可以使用它。

segments.en: They were more efficient into keeping heat or keeping the cold.
segments.zh: 他们更有效地保持热量或保持寒冷。

segments.en: And also, what we saw in the vocab, they also had rain barrels.
segments.zh: 而且，我们在词汇中看到的，他们也有雨桶。

segments.en: So basically, collecting water from the rain, and then they can use this water, obviously, through a filtering system in order to be able to drink it or to wash your clothes and stuff.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，从雨中收集水，然后他们可以使用这些水，显然，通过过滤系统，以便能够饮用或洗衣服和东西。

segments.en: But basically, they would say that it could reduce your carbon footprint by more than 50% and also the amount of money you would spend because you wouldn't spend so much money on water, you wouldn't spend so much money on electricity or gas and things like this.
segments.zh: 但基本上，他们会说它可以将您的碳足迹减少 50% 以上，也可以将您花费的金额减少，因为您不会在水上花费这么多钱，您不会在电或汽油和类似的事情上花那么多钱。

segments.en: That's awesome.
segments.zh: 太棒了。

segments.en: Well, one of the biggest concerns as far as environmentalism is water, where water will come from in 50 years because there is a limited amount of fresh water in the world.
segments.zh: 好吧，就环保主义而言，最大的担忧之一是水，因为世界上的淡水量有限，50 年后水将来自哪里。

segments.en: And if we can reuse rainwater and collect it, I think it's brilliant.
segments.zh: 如果我们可以重复使用雨水并收集它，我认为它很棒。

segments.en: So a barrel basically is like a big container, circular.
segments.zh: 所以一个桶基本上就像一个大容器，圆形。

segments.en: It's like a circle and it stands up on the ground or on a roof.
segments.zh: 它就像一个圆圈，它站在地上或屋顶上。

segments.en: And it's brilliant because if you have a rain barrel that collects all this rain, and you have solar panels, basically, you don't need gas or electricity to take a warm shower.
segments.zh: 这太棒了，因为如果你有一个雨桶来收集所有这些雨水，而且你有太阳能电池板，基本上，你不需要煤气或电来洗个热水澡。

segments.en: You just have the solar panels that can heat up the rain barrel water and there you have a warm shower.
segments.zh: 你只有太阳能电池板可以加热雨桶水，然后你就有一个热水淋浴。

segments.en: It sounds so nice.
segments.zh: 听起来真好。

segments.en: You have sun-kissed warmth and you have fresh rainwater.
segments.zh: 你有阳光亲吻的温暖，你有新鲜的雨水。

segments.en: But the whole water issue is a very popular topic.
segments.zh: 但整个水问题是一个非常受欢迎的话题。

segments.en: I recommend that any of our listeners read.
segments.zh: 我建议我们的任何听众都阅读。

segments.en: There's a very interesting article that talks about don't worry about petroleum running out in 50 years.
segments.zh: 有一篇非常有趣的文章谈到了不要担心 50 年来石油耗尽。

segments.en: We're probably going to run out of our water before that.
segments.zh: 在此之前，我们可能会用完水。

segments.en: And they project droughts and huge famine in places like India, like in the Middle East, even in places of China.
segments.zh: 他们会在印度等地，像中东，甚至在中国的地方引发干旱和大饥荒。

segments.en: Really?
segments.zh: 真的吗？

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well, not to scare anyone.
segments.zh: 好吧，不要吓到任何人。

segments.en: But yeah, it's interesting reading though.
segments.zh: 但是，是的，虽然读起来很有趣。

segments.en: Yeah, it's really good.
segments.zh: 是的，真的很好。

segments.en: Very serious stuff.
segments.zh: 很严重的东西。

segments.en: Well, the last thing that I think we should talk about before we listen to today's audio file again is the compost bin.
segments.zh: 好吧，在我们再次听今天的音频文件之前，我认为我们应该谈论的最后一件事是堆肥箱。

segments.en: Now, this is maybe something that's hard to understand for someone who's never seen one before.
segments.zh: 现在，对于以前从未见过的人来说，这可能是难以理解的事情。

segments.en: But basically, compost is, well, the verb is compost, to compost, but it's also a noun.
segments.zh: 但基本上，堆肥是，动词是堆肥，是堆肥，但它也是一个名词。

segments.en: But a lot of people, they don't want to throw away their food and their organic material, things like flowers and food and biodegradable things.
segments.zh: 但是很多人，他们不想扔掉他们的食物和有机材料，比如鲜花和食物以及可生物降解的东西。

segments.en: They actually reuse them.
segments.zh: 他们实际上重复使用它们。

segments.en: They have a space in the backyard of the house where they throw away all the old food.
segments.zh: 他们在房子的后院有一个空间，在那里他们扔掉了所有的旧食物。

segments.en: Nothing plastic, nothing non-biodegradable.
segments.zh: 没有塑料，没有不可生物降解的。

segments.en: And that over time turns into fertilizer or mulch for their gardens.
segments.zh: 随着时间的推移，这变成了他们花园的肥料或覆盖物。

segments.en: So basically, you're putting it back into the earth.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，你把它放回地球上。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: No, this is a very good option.
segments.zh: 不，这是一个非常好的选择。

segments.en: And I remember seeing that even in Brazil, they have huge compost bins or compost places that they fill up with this garbage.
segments.zh: 我记得即使在巴西，它们也有巨大的堆肥箱或堆肥场所，它们装满了这些垃圾。

segments.en: And obviously, things that decompose start to emit methane gas.
segments.zh: 显然，分解的东西开始排放甲烷气体。

segments.en: So they've found a way to harness this gas, transport it through tubes, and start using it.
segments.zh: 所以他们找到了一种方法来利用这种气体，通过管子运输它，并开始使用它。

segments.en: So actually having gas stoves with this methane gas.
segments.zh: 所以实际上有这种甲烷气体的燃气灶。

segments.en: That's brilliant.
segments.zh: 那太棒了。

segments.en: So two uses, fertilizer and methane gas.
segments.zh: 所以两种用途，化肥和甲烷气体。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So there are a lot of options there to go green, to do your part to help the earth.
segments.zh: 因此，有很多选择可以绿色环保，尽自己的一份力量来帮助地球。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: So let's listen again to the dialogue that we had today.
segments.zh: 所以让我们再听一遍我们今天的对话。

segments.en: Hopefully we've cleared up some of the things that were confusing for you, and we'll be back in just a moment.
segments.zh: 希望我们已经清除了一些让您感到困惑的事情，我们稍后会回来。

segments.en: So what's your guys' take on all this global warming hysteria in the media?
segments.zh: 那么，您对媒体中所有这些全球变暖歇斯底里的看法是什么？

segments.en: It's pretty serious, man.
segments.zh: 这很严重，伙计。

segments.en: There have been tons of scientific studies, and the scientific community says that the earth is heating up.
segments.zh: 有大量的科学研究，科学界说地球正在升温。

segments.en: We need to make some drastic changes to our lifestyle if we want to preserve our planet.
segments.zh: 如果我们想保护我们的星球，我们需要对我们的生活方式做出一些重大改变。

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: It sounds like a bunch of mumble jumble if you ask me.
segments.zh: 要我说，这听起来就是一通胡言乱语。

segments.en: The earth will save itself.
segments.zh: 地球将自救。

segments.en: It's survived the worst disasters in the past.
segments.zh: 它在过去最严重的灾难中幸存下来。

segments.en: I mean, honestly, we live in the boonies.
segments.zh: 说实话，咱们住在这偏僻乡下。

segments.en: There's no way anyone here is ever going to walk or bike to work, especially in the winter.
segments.zh: 这里的任何人都不可能步行或骑自行车上班，尤其是在冬天。

segments.en: And we have no bus system.
segments.zh: 而且我们没有公共汽车系统。

segments.en: My house is 40 years old, and it would take a lot of money to get it refitted to be green and energy efficient.
segments.zh: 我的房子有 40 年的历史，要把它改装成绿色和节能需要很多钱。

segments.en: Well, I don't really know if I believe in global warming either, or whether or not it was our doing or a natural change the earth is going through.
segments.zh: 好吧，我真的不知道我是否相信全球变暖，或者这是否是我们所做的事情，或者是地球正在经历的自然变化。

segments.en: But you have to admit that we're living pretty irresponsibly here in the West.
segments.zh: 但你不得不承认，我们在西方不负责任地生活。

segments.en: I guess.
segments.zh: 我想是吧。

segments.en: I think the issue at hand is sustainability.
segments.zh: 我认为手头的问题是可持续性。

segments.en: We've only got this one earth we can live on, and our resources are quickly disappearing because of our own carelessness and our inability to think of anyone but ourselves and anything but the present.
segments.zh: 我们只有这个地球可以生存，我们的资源正在迅速消失，因为我们自己的粗心和我们无法想到除了我们自己和任何人之外的任何人。

segments.en: So like I was saying, we need to change the way we live.
segments.zh: 所以就像我说的，我们需要改变我们的生活方式。

segments.en: We need to reduce our carbon footprint.
segments.zh: 我们需要减少我们的碳足迹。

segments.en: But it doesn't have to be that drastic.
segments.zh: 但它不必那么激烈。

segments.en: Hybrid vehicles and solar panels are too expensive to be feasible right now.
segments.zh: 混合动力汽车和太阳能电池板现在太昂贵，无法实现。

segments.en: And we don't have to be hippies living off the land and buying everything organic either, though it helps.
segments.zh: 而且我们不必成为生活在土地上的嬉皮士，也不必购买所有有机产品，尽管它有帮助。

segments.en: I carpool to work every day with some buddies of mine.
segments.zh: 我每天和我的一些朋友拼车上班。

segments.en: I have a rain barrel outside my house I use to water my plants and my lawn in the summer.
segments.zh: 我家外面放了一个收集雨水的桶，夏天就用里面的水浇花和浇草坪。

segments.en: And I make sure I always bring reusable bags with me when I get my groceries.
segments.zh: 我确保在我拿到杂货时总是随身携带可重复使用的袋子。

segments.en: And we just started using biodegradable plastic made from corn oil for takeout orders at my family's restaurant.
segments.zh: 我们刚刚开始在我家的餐厅使用由玉米油制成的可生物降解塑料进行外卖订单。

segments.en: Remember the three R's?
segments.zh: 还记得三个R的吗？

segments.en: Reduce, reuse, recycle.
segments.zh: 减少、重复使用、回收。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: It's just small, simple changes.
segments.zh: 它只是很小的，简单的变化。

segments.en: Like buying energy-saving light bulbs.
segments.zh: 喜欢购买节能灯泡。

segments.en: Starting a compost bin.
segments.zh: 启动堆肥箱。

segments.en: Recycling bottles and papers.
segments.zh: 回收瓶子和纸张。

segments.en: Using reusable water bottles.
segments.zh: 使用可重复使用的水瓶。

segments.en: Stop using disposable cups and cutlery.
segments.zh: 停止使用一次性杯子和餐具。

segments.en: Like the ones we're drinking out of?
segments.zh: 就像我们喝的那些？

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So it's a very interesting topic, very debatable.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常有趣的话题，非常有争议。

segments.en: We have Earth Day coming up, I think.
segments.zh: 我想我们即将迎来地球日。

segments.en: You have to turn off your lights for an hour.
segments.zh: 你必须关掉你的灯一个小时。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Earth Hour, Earth Day.
segments.zh: 地球一小时，地球日。

segments.en: So remember, reduce, reuse, recycle.
segments.zh: 所以记住，减少，重复使用，回收。

segments.en: The three R's.
segments.zh: 三个R。

segments.en: Think about the way that you use things and try and reuse them if you can.
segments.zh: 想想你使用事物的方式，并尝试重复使用它们。

segments.en: It's a very good topic.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常好的话题。

segments.en: We want to know what you think about it.
segments.zh: 我们想知道您对此有何看法。

segments.zh: 而且，如果您对未来的高级课程有任何建议或任何意见，您为什么不告诉我们？
